headline: 3 tourists die, 2 missing at Himchari beach in Cox’s Bazar
summary: The victims were part of two groups from Dhaka and Chattogram who entered the sea for a swim on Wednesday evening.
details: Three tourists have died and two others remain missing after entering the sea for a swim at Himchari beach in Cox’s Bazar.
The incident occurred around 5pm on Wednesday near the museum beside Marina Resort, according to Dolon Acharya, senior station officer at Cox’s Bazar Fire Service and Civil Defence.
The victims were part of two separate groups: one from Bayezid in Chattogram and the other from Uttara in Dhaka.
One tourist was rescued and is currently receiving treatment at Cox’s Bazar Sadar Hospital.
The identities of those killed and missing have not been immediately released.
caption:
3 tourists dead, 2 still missing after a swim at Himchari beach.

Three tourists have died and two others remain missing after entering the sea for a swim at Himchari beach in Cox’s Bazar.

The incident occurred around 5pm on Wednesday near the museum beside Marina Resort, according to Dolon Acharya, senior station officer at Cox’s Bazar Fire Service and Civil Defence.

The victims were part of two separate groups: one from Bayezid in Chattogram and the other from Uttara in Dhaka.

One tourist was rescued and is currently receiving treatment at Cox’s Bazar Sadar Hospital.

The identities of those killed and missing have not been immediately released.
